source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Modular Ice Maker Service Sheet (Part 2225623, 120 V)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before resistance checks or module removal. Restore power only for live voltage checks when required.
steps.sourceExcerpt: MODULE OHMMETER CHECKS (no power; ejector blades in PARK).

steps.title: Prepare for L–M ohms
steps.body: Test points L, N, M, T, H, V are stamped on the circuit module (3 Phillips removal screws). Pull water-adjust knob and snap off cover for access. Ejector blades must be in park for resistance tests. Do not manually start the cycle — initiate electrically only. Align "D" coupling on reinstall. Disconnect motor from support; blades in park; power off.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Test points L, N, M, T, H, V are stamped on the circuit module (3 Phillips removal screws). Pull water-adjust knob and snap off cover for access. Ejector blades must be in park for resistance tests. Do not manually start the cycle — initiate electrically only. Align "D" coupling on reinstall. Disconnect motor from support; blades in park; power off.

steps.title: Motor winding resistance (L–M)
steps.body: 1.5 W motor = 8800 Ω at L–M with motor disconnected from support.
steps.sourceExcerpt: 1.5 W motor = 8800 Ω at L–M with motor disconnected from support.

steps.title: Live motor voltage (L–M)
steps.body: Restore power and initiate cycle electrically. L–M line voltage = motor ON; 0 V = OFF.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Restore power and initiate cycle electrically. L–M line voltage = motor ON; 0 V = OFF.

steps.title: Motor energizes during cycle?
steps.body: During eject phase, does L–M show line voltage and blades rotate?
steps.sourceExcerpt: During eject phase, does L–M show line voltage and blades rotate?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Motor ohms OK but no rotation — cam coupling or module control (IME2/E2).

steps.title: Replace ice maker module
steps.oemOutcome: Open or out-of-spec L–M motor — replace module (IME2/E2 motor home not found).

steps.title: Check cam coupling
steps.oemOutcome: Verify "D" coupling alignment; replace module if cam damaged.

steps.title: Motor circuit verified
steps.oemOutcome: L–M 8800 Ω and eject motor voltage verified.
